heading: Missed FD Income: How to Rectify and What Happens If You Don't
tldr: Fixed Deposit (FD) interest income is fully taxable under Indian income tax laws.
If you missed declaring FD interest in your original Income Tax Return (ITR), you can file an Updated Return (ITR-U).
ITR-U allows corrections for up to two assessment years from the end of the relevant assessment year.
Filing an ITR-U incurs an additional tax penalty, which increases with the delay in filing.
Ignoring undeclared FD income can lead to scrutiny, higher penalties, and potential prosecution by the Income Tax Department.
caption:
Oops, forgot to tell the taxman about your FD interest? It happens! But ignoring it can lead to bigger headaches and more money out of your pocket. The good news is, there's a way to fix it without too much stress. Learn how to correct past mistakes and why it's super important not to delay. Read more to understand your options.
